other_conditions: Must be registered with the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers' State Social Security Board
Must be registered with the Regional Transport Office (RTO)
Must possess a commercial vehicle driver's licence
Must have been registered with the board for at least 90 days
Each beneficiary can receive the scheme benefits only once
Beneficiaries who have already received benefits from any other equivalent state scheme are ineligible
benefits_summary: A grant of ₹30,000 is provided, and the remaining amount is extended as a bank loan, with the board transferring its contribution after loan documents are submitted.
